title: Benchmarking the State of AI for Crop Yield Forecasting: A Global Assessment Across Modeling Paradigms
abstract: arXiv:2611.19330v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate crop yield forecasting is essential for food security, agricultural policy, and commodity markets. Although statistical, process-based, and machine learning approaches have all been proposed, their relative strengths remain poorly understood due to the lack of large-scale, standardized comparisons. We address this gap through a comprehensive benchmark of five modeling paradigms -- statistical baselines, process-based models, conventional feature-engineered machine learning, deep sequence models, and tabular foundation models -- using the CY-Bench benchmark spanning 63 country-crop datasets (>12,000 administrative regions) across six continents. Beyond conventional pooled accuracy metrics, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that separately quantifies overall, spatial, temporal, and anomaly prediction skill. Across multiple crops and countries, feature-engineered machine learning and tabular foundation models

translated_title: 基准测试作物产量预测的AI现状：跨建模范式的全球评估
translated_abstract: 准确的作物产量预测对粮食安全、农业政策和商品市场至关重要。尽管统计方法、基于过程的方法和机器学习方法都已被提出，但由于缺乏大规模、标准化的比较，它们的相对优势仍知之甚少。我们通过使用CY-Bench基准（涵盖六大洲63个国家-作物数据集，超过12,000个行政区域），对五种建模范式——统计基线、基于过程的模型、传统特征工程机器学习、深度序列模型和表格基础模型——进行全面基准测试来填补这一空白。除了传统的汇总精度指标外，我们还引入了一个多维评估框架，分别量化总体、空间、时间和异常预测能力。在多种作物和国家中，特征工程机器学习和表格基础模型……
tldr: 该研究构建了涵盖六大洲63个国家-作物数据集的多维评估基准，系统比较了五种建模范式在作物产量预测中的表现，发现特征工程机器学习和表格基础模型表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This study establishes a multi-dimensional benchmark spanning 63 country-crop datasets across six continents to systematically compare five modeling paradigms for crop yield forecasting, finding that feature-engineered machine learning and tabular foundation models perform best.
